newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, Japan PM Hashimoto plan April 25 meet.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Japan PM Hashimoto plan April 25 meet.

text.p: President Clinton and Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto plan an April 25 meeting, White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.
McCurry, talking briefly to reporters, had no details on the agenda of the meeting, but economic relations would figure to be a top priority.
He did not say where the meeting would take place, although Washington was likely given Clinton's recovery from knee surgery.
